guide.content:
SnowDesktop Multi-Screen Paging System

=== Core Concepts ===
• First Screen — Defaults to the primary monitor and can be locked to any display
• Last Screen — Defaults to the rightmost monitor and can be locked to any display
• Each of the first N-1 monitors shows one fixed page
• The last screen can browse all overflow pages
• With one monitor, it serves as both the first and last screen

=== Basic Operations ===
Turn Pages
  Click the arrows on either side of the last screen when they appear; while dragging, hover there briefly to turn pages, or use Previous Page/Next Page in the context menu

Go To
  Use Go To in the context menu to jump directly to a page

Add Page
  Use Add Page in the context menu to create a blank page
  A guide widget is placed automatically to keep the blank page from being cleaned up

Lock First/Last Page
  Use Pin First/Last Page > Pin This Monitor as First Screen in the context menu
  Use Pin First/Last Page > Pin This Monitor as Last Screen in the context menu
  The two locks are mutually exclusive; select one again to clear it
  Locks persist and are retained while a monitor is offline

=== Tips ===
• Empty overflow pages are cleaned up automatically
• This guide widget can be removed manually from the context menu
